description:
## 1.36.0-dev.115 (2026-08-10)

- Reddit: enter the visible comment list directly after post-detail scrolling, even when Reddit exposes no focused Compose node.
- Reddit: retain comment selection while the next parent or child comment is being composed off-screen.
- Reddit: resume at the correct visible comment boundary after scrolling instead of clearing the selector.
- Reddit: constrain exceptionally large preview bitmaps before drawing to prevent Canvas crashes.
- Reddit: leave normal HQ preview resolution and existing key behavior unchanged.
